tool.name: PyEuk generate-sheet
tool.description: build a haplotype sheet from BLAST calls or assembled contigs, PyEuk generate-sheet
tool.command: #if $source.kind == "specimen_zip" pyeuk generate-sheet --specimen-dir '$source.specimen_zip' #if $source.background_zip --background-dir '$source.background_zip' #end if #if $source.de_novo --de-novo #end if --output '$sheet' #else pyeuk generate-sheet --assembled-fasta '$source.assembled_fasta' #if $source.de_novo_fa --de-novo #end if --output '$sheet' #end if

param.name: specimen_zip
param.label: Specimen genotype files (.zip)
param.help: A .zip of per-specimen genotype BLAST calls.

param.label: De novo (no reference database)
param.help: Discover loci and alleles with no reference database.

param.label: Assembled haplotype contigs (FASTA)
param.help: A FASTA of externally assembled haplotype contigs.

param.name: de_novo_fa
param.label: De novo (no reference database)
param.help: Discover loci and alleles with no reference database.

tool.help:
Builds a specimen-by-haplotype sheet from haplotypes called outside the amplicon read-level path -- genotype BLAST files, or externally assembled contigs. For amplicon reads use Build haplotype sheet instead.
Provide either a .zip of per-specimen genotype BLAST calls (with an optional background .zip of reference genotypes), or a FASTA of assembled contigs with de novo discovery of loci and alleles. Output is a specimen-by-haplotype sheet in the format the distance and cluster tools consume. @HELP_FOOTER@
